# Aurelian Massage

> Swedish and aromatherapy massage in Bath city centre, run by massage therapist Ross. Each session is tailored to the client's body and needs. Rated 5.0 on Google. Bookings are taken online through Fresha.

- Address: 11 St James's Parade, Bath BA1 1UL
- Phone: 07388 007570
- Email: ross@aurelianmassage.com
- Opening hours: Monday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday, 10am to 5pm
- Clients come from Bath, Bristol and Frome
- Book online: https://www.fresha.com/book-now/aurelian-massage-x0r1utrz/all-offer?share=true&pId=2823885
